# formal_dashboard (Resource)

A saved dashboard of logs, AI usage, and note widgets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "formal_dashboard" "ai_usage" {
  name = "AI usage"
  definition = jsonencode({
    layout = { columns = 1 }
    widgets = [{
      key    = "providers"
      layout = { span = 1 }
      logs = {
        visualization = "DASHBOARD_VISUALIZATION_BARS"
        group_by      = ["llm.provider"]
      }
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) The JSON form of the `core.v1.DashboardDefinition` message, usually written with `jsonencode`.
- `name` (String) The name of the dashboard.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the dashboard.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import formal_dashboard.ai_usage '<dashboard_id>'
```
